result.summary: Both task slots pass. All 3 R groups (cs_demean/cs_winsor/cross_valid_count fixes on the wstd head; cs_demean/cs_rank fix on the day_wmean(Ret,Amt) head; cs_demean on either leg of the cross_regbeta head to test for a shared market factor) score soundness 4 — operators verified against source for no lookahead, no near-zero division, no degenerate panels.
